<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/imports/{id}/rows"}
#docs
Rows come in file order: by file, then by row number.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | The import's id. |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | `string` | no | Only rows of this file. |
| `state` | `string` | no | Only rows with this state at the check. |
| `outcome` | `string` | no | Only rows with this result. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Rows per page. Default 100. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | The last row id of the previous page. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `import_row`. One of `import_row`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The row's id. |
| `data.entity` | `string` | The file the row is in. One of `plans`, `addons`, `coupons`, `customers`, `subscriptions`, `invoices`, `credit_notes`, `payments`, `usage`. |
| `data.row_number` | `integer` | The data row in the file. The header line is row 0. |
| `data.source_id` | `string | null` | The row's id column. |
| `data.state` | `string | null` | At the check: `new` is imported; `existing` is in the business already and stays as it is; `invalid` has errors; `excluded` is left out. One of `new`, `existing`, `invalid`, `excluded`, `null`. |
| `data.outcome` | `string | null` | After the run: what happened to the row. One of `created`, `unchanged`, `failed`, `excluded`, `null`. |
| `data.outcome_message` | `string | null` | Why the row failed or was left out. |
| `data.errors` | `array of object` | Problems that stop the row. |
| `data.warnings` | `array of object` | Problems that do not stop the row. Same shape as `errors`. |
| `data.values` | `object` | The row's cells, by column name, as uploaded. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | True when there is another page. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | One page of rows |
| `404` | No such import |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/imports/XXXXXXXXXXXX01/rows?limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
